auth.wa-too-many-free.ha: Ƙoƙari ya yi yawa don wannan lambar. Jira awa ɗaya, ko ka yi amfani da Telegram maimakon haka.
auth.wa-too-many-free.ig: Mgbalị karịrị akarị maka nọmba a. Chere otu awa, ma ọ bụ jiri Telegram kama.
auth.wa-too-many-free.yo: Ìgbìyànjú ti pọ̀ jù fún nọ́mbà yìí. Dúró fún wákàtí kan, tàbí lo Telegram dípò bẹ́ẹ̀.

auth.wa-unavailable.ha: Shiga ta WhatsApp ba ya samuwa yanzu. Yi amfani da Telegram maimakon haka.
auth.wa-unavailable.ig: Ịbanye site na WhatsApp adịghị ugbu a. Jiri Telegram kama.
auth.wa-unavailable.yo: Wíwọlé pẹ̀lú WhatsApp kò sí lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́. Lo Telegram dípò bẹ́ẹ̀.

observe.prefer-whatsapp-free.ha: Ka fi son WhatsApp? Tabbatar a can maimakon haka.
observe.prefer-whatsapp-free.ig: Ị kacha mmasị WhatsApp? Kwado n'ebe ahụ kama.
observe.prefer-whatsapp-free.yo: Ṣé o fẹ́ràn WhatsApp jù? Ṣe ìfìdímúlẹ̀ níbẹ̀ dípò rẹ̀.
